sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can express unfulfilled obligations and violated prohibitions with kellett volna and nem szabadott volna.
I can discuss preventable outcomes with -hatott/-hetett volna and lehetett volna + infinitive.
I can evaluate foreseeability and moral responsibility with tudhatta volna and sejthette volna.
